record.rationale: Task183 repairs loss of new represented native Font paint/alignment/size fields in Writer browser document/Worker records. One shared vcl/browser metadata codec transports actual Font values using existing Color/Size owners;Writer keeps its existing family-name/presence ownership fields and delegates metadata encode/restore. Complete current groups preserve packed alpha colors,independent transparency,alignment and signed safe-integer geometry. Validation rejects malformed/partial new groups before mutating the actual Font;legacy four-field metadata restores absent new values from a genuine default Font at the existing browser I/O boundary. Fill precedes explicit transparency to preserve native independent flags. Core Font/Color/Size/numbering and ODF algorithms remain unchanged. This is browser primitive transport,not a native wire format,service or class facsimile. Full unrepresented Font/config/device/rendering and actual Calc pool/document/UI/same-model ODS remain pending;registered save/open/recovery deviations and broad parity statuses are preserved. Task6764KT adds source stored Font weight and italic with original WEIGHT_DONTKNOW/ITALIC_NONE defaults, const no-config getters, guarded setters, copy/assignment and represented EqualIgnoreColor participation. Browser metadata records transport both values as an optional complete pair so pre-face records restore actual native defaults; malformed groups fail before mutation. Actual Writer numbering and structured-clone document transport retain nondefault values. MaybeAskConfig, physical face selection and popup/style drawing remain pending; no broad parity promotion or native lifetime machinery.
responsibilities: Lossless primitive transport and validation of actual represented Font values at browser/Worker boundaries.

stackDivergence.rationale: Structured-clone document records preserve logical native values without a native binary data layout or ownership engine.
